subject: Import update [bug fix] in MSstatsTMT (v.2.4.1) is live on Bioconductor

messages.author: 5c6e92c10ef28984
messages.subject: Import update [bug fix] in MSstatsTMT (v.2.4.1) is live on Bioconductor
parts:
Dear Users,

there was a hard to catch bug in protein-level normalization in MSstatsTMT (thank you to Salvador Martinez who reported it). The bug was due to changes in the R interpretation of NA values.

The bug affected MSstatsTMT version 2.4 after the release of Bioconductor 3.15. We worked hard on locating and addressing the issue, and now MSstatsTMT version 2.4.1 fixes that.

We apologize for this issue and advise re-running analyses that might be affected.

Kind regards,
Mateusz Staniak
